name: Real-world espresso reference shots
description: Four shot-level references from Jonathan Gagne's EG-1 vs Niche blooming espresso experiment.
important_note: No telemetry was fabricated. timeseries and final_shot_time_s were populated by tools/import_shot_telemetry.py from the original DE1 .shot files (the article's zipped shot-file package, no explicit license stated for that archive -- see each record's source.data_quality.timeseries and docs/real-shot-validation.md). Everything this catalogue still cannot supply -- basket diameter, puck depth, particle size distribution, a measured brew temperature -- remains null; these shots are for shape comparison and provenance, not calibration or validation.
